paper_protocol.data_risk_heuristic: Cramers V is used only for ordering feasible candidates; at most three paired probes per run. No hard V promotion threshold.
paper_protocol.note: Metadata-assisted training-only discovery. Quantitative selects one eligible versioned memory recipe before training and held-out evaluation; no caller-selected transformation. Frozen adaptive thresholds and six-model matrix unchanged. Independent original OOD remains separate.
paper_protocol.effect_reporting: Continuous signed paired effects and uncertainty; no universal 30pp shortcut/no-shortcut boundary.

split_protocol.isolation: SHA256 of max(RGB) digit foreground, groups isolated; training content overlapping original OOD excluded
split_protocol.original_test_role: original IRM independent OOD environment retained, unused for model selection

dataset_description: Binary handwritten digit classification from RGB 14x14 images on black backgrounds. Observed y is the task target. Discovery receives training only, with color verified against pixels. Validation and held-out ID/OOD are isolated by digit-content groups. Quantitative must select an eligible deterministic intervention from its versioned recipe memory using training-only input facts and current-task cheap evidence before training. Do not assume an expected verdict. Equivalent visual and metadata representations are one hypothesis when supported.
